pinned_current_source_facets.authority: The route and policy require incidents.approve and reviewed state. closed_outcome is required; closed_notes is optional. healthSafety.viewAllSites or reports.viewAny may broaden Site scope but do not replace incidents.approve.
pinned_current_source_facets.site_direct_object: Site access is asserted before and under the incident lock. Foreign-Site denial is explicit 403, not concealed 404. A malformed or conflicting canonical journey is converted to 404.
pinned_current_source_facets.state_read_effects: Closure requires review actor/time evidence, no incomplete follow-ups, completed required high/critical investigation, and closed linked H&S governance. It transitions reviewed to closed with closer, time, outcome, notes, and a lifecycle signal outbox.
pinned_current_source_facets.audit_provenance: ClientIncident stores closure actor/time/outcome/notes and uses AuditableChanges. The same transaction records an append-only lifecycle signal containing actor, Client, Site, H&S tuple, sequence, fingerprint, and idempotency key plus a recoverable outbox. Database triggers make lifecycle signals immutable.
pinned_current_source_facets.transaction_locking_replay: A three-attempt transaction locks the parent incident, canonicalizes and locks journey parents, evaluates the gate, writes closure, locks the latest lifecycle signal, and writes the outbox. Repeat close is state-rejected rather than same-result replay. Outbox dispatch is recoverable; the separate CRUD notification has no exactly-once contract.
collisions_gaps: Investigation, follow-ups, corrective actions, H&S governance, and Control Room processing are external prerequisites, not incident-closure ownership.
No caller request key or same-result close replay exists.
Tests are source locators only and were not executed.
